notes: This budget is a soft, approximate working limit for scope-per-session, not an exact measured token count (the environment does not expose precise per-session token usage to the model).
Each development session should target ONE milestone from DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md, sized to comfortably fit under this budget.
When a session's scope grows large (many files, large generated code, long exploration), stop at the next logical checkpoint rather than pushing further, even if the milestone isn't 100% finished.
Always update SESSION_CHECKPOINT.md before stopping so the next session (which may be a fresh context) can resume without rediscovery.
